title: 4 field-cube components with two-sided bounded search

claims.statement: The explicit 4-component degree-250 field-cube encoder with its stated two-sided radius-29/26 decoder for 1000 bits on 2000 independent BSC(1/10) uses has average block error at most 26756287227241409/50000000000000000.
The same bsc-ops-v1 two-sided decoder uses at most W=157186451944824355715068710708965957968284 operations on every received word, with W<=2^(34213/250).

experiments.purpose: Check exact digit-coefficient imbalance envelopes, occupied-volume error, field irreducibility, fixed root circuit and both search counts.
